170.315 (b)(10) EHI Export Documentation
Office Ally provides an export of electronic health information (EHI) for a single patient as well
as for a patient population in the following computable formats:
       1. CCDA:
          Office Ally EHR 24/7 supports bulk export of HL7 CCDA xml files which comply to
          United States Core Data for Interoperability (USCDI), Version 1 requirements.

           The specifications for the CCDA can be obtained from the HL7 website:
           C-CDA (HL7 CDA® R2 Implementation Guide: Consolidated CDA Templates for
           Clinical Notes - US Realm)

       2. Appointments:

           •   This file offers a comprehensive view of appointment details, the data will be
               exported in CSV format

       3. Claims:

           •   This file offers a comprehensive view of claim details, the data will be exported
               in CSV format

       4. Attachments:

           •   Contains any scanned or uploaded documents in the patient’s record, the files
               will be exported in the format in which they were uploaded

Product Name and Version:
Office Ally EHR 24/7 5.6.81
